name: Cartomancer Decks
body:
The following is the composition of each of the three cartomancer decks, and the effect of a joker, which is universal to all decks.

Joker

Traits abjuration, wild

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target spellcaster
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

When a target within range begins casting a spell, you can play this card as an immediate action to attempt to counter the spellcasting. To counter the spell, you must make a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the spell’s level.

Empower (1 card, jokers only) You gain a +2 bonus on your check.

Arcane Deck
Ace of Hearts – Allied Swap

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one willing ally
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

When you would take damage from an attack, you can play this card as an immediate action swap places with a willing ally within range. The ally takes the damage and other effects of the triggering attack.

Empower (3 cards) You do not use your immediate action for the round in casting this spell.

Two of Hearts – Mystic Extension

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

Choose one ongoing spell affecting you. You extend the spell’s duration by 1 round.

Empower (1 card) You can target another willing creature with a range of touch.

Empower (3 cards) You extend the duration by an additional round.

Three of Hearts – Dragon Sight

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

Your eyes transform into those of a true dragon. You gain a 60-foot darkvision or improvise your existing darkvision by 30 feet.

Empower (1 card) You can target another willing creature with a range of touch.

Empower (2 cards) The duration extends to 1 min/level.

Empower (2 cards) The darkvision range increases by 30 feet.

Four of Hearts – Flash Fade

Traits illusion

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You are invisible as per the spell vanish for 1 round.

Five of Hearts – Minor Mirror

Traits illusion

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You gain the benefits of mirror image but with only one image. Once the image is destroyed, the spell ends.

Empower (1 card) You can target another willing creature with a range of touch.

Empower (2 cards) The spell no longer ends when the image is destroyed. Instead another image reappears on your next turn.

Six of Hearts – Time Transfer

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action or standard action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target willing target
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

The target may immediately take the action you used to cast this spell.

Empower (1 card) The range increases to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Seven of Hearts – Dragon’s Nose

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You gain scent as the universal monster ability.

Empower (1 card) You can target another willing creature with a range of touch.

Empower (2 cards) The duration extends to 1 min/level.

Eight of Hearts – Tail Sweep

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You briefly grow a draconic tail. You gain a tail slap attack that deals 1d8 damage for a medium creature, or 1d6 for a Small creature. This tail slap automatically allows for a trip attempt on a hit.

Empower (1 card) Your reach with this attack increases by 5 feet.

Empower (2 cards) The duration extends by 1 round.

Nine of Hearts – Ablative Ward

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level or until expended

DESCRIPTION

When a spellcaster within range begins casting a spell, as an immediate action you can attempt to counter the spellcasting. To counter the spell, you must make a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the spell’s level.

This only counters the spell for you if it affects multiple creatures. Once this effect is used, the spell ends. You cannot prevent spells that are area-of-effect.

Empower (1 card) You can target another willing creature with a range of touch.

Empower (2 cards) The duration extends by 1 round.

Ten of Hearts – Spirit of Lore

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a spirit of lore and lost knowledge to partially possess you. For the duration, you are treated as having all Knowledge and Lore skills as class skills and a minimum of 1 rank in each skill.

Jack of Hearts – Dragon Scales

Traits acid, cold, electricity, fire, transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You gain the effects of mage armor and protection from energy for the duration.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Empower (3 cards) The ac bonus from the mage armor effect increases to +8.

Queen of Hearts – Warp Step

Traits conjuration, teleportation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You can teleport as per the spell dimension door to a location within 5 feet plus 5 feet per two caster levels.

Empower (2 cards) You can carry 1 additional willing creature within touch range with you.

King of Hearts – Mirror Shield

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a free-floating mirrored shield. The next time you are targeted by a spell, you can spend an immediate action to attempt to reflect it. Make a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the spell’s level.

If successful, the effect is turned back on the caster.

Whether or not the counteract attempt is successful, this effect ends. This spell can’t affect spells that aren’t targeted (such as area spells).

Empower (1 card) You can target another willing creature with a range of touch.

Empower (2 cards) The duration extends by 1 round.

Diamonds
Ace of Diamonds – Kinetic Transfer

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

If you take damage from a target within 30 feet of you, you steal some of their energy. You may make a single weapon or natural attack or move action. The target must make a Will save or be stunned for the rest of its turn.

Two of Diamonds – Force Bands

Traits evocation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You wrap the target in bands of force. They must make a Reflex save or be grappled. The DC of the Escape Artist or grapple check is equal to your card casting DC.

Empower (1 card) The range changes to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Empower (1 card) You can target another creature within range.

Three of Diamonds – Mystic Blockade

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You touch the creature and they must make a Will save.

On a failure, they take a 25% spell failure chance.

Empower (1 card) The range changes to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Empower (1 card) You can target another creature within range.

Four of Diamonds – Hypnotic Glance

Traits enchantment, mind-affecting

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You lock eyes with the target and they must make a Will save or be fascinated.

Empower (1 card) The range changes to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Empower (1 card) You can target another creature within range.

Five of Diamonds – Lecture

Traits enchantment, mind-affecting

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range 10 feet
Area burst centered on you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You begin a discourse on magical theory. Each creature in the area is put to sleep by your droning voice. Each creature in the area must make a Will save or fall asleep as per the sleep spell with no HD limit. Affected creatures do not drop what they are holding or fall prone.

Empower (1 card) The burst radius increases by 5 feet.

Six of Diamonds – Mystic Suppression

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You inhibit the target’s ability to project magic. The DC of all caster level checks against the target, including dispelling, counterspelling, or spell resistance, are reduced by 2. This also is imposed upon the target’s own caster level checks for opposed rolls or casting defensively.

Seven of Diamonds – Slow Breath

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range 15 feet
Area cone
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You exhale out a cloud of slowing gas. Each creature in the area must make a Fortitude saving throw or be slowed as per the spell slow for 1 round.

Empower (1 card) The cone range increases by 5 feet.

Eight of Diamonds – Fear Aura

Traits enchantment, mind-affecting, fear

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range 20 feet
Area 20-ft radius emanation centered on you
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You project an aura of fear like that of a dragon. Enemies that come within the aura must make a Will save. On a failure, the target is shaken. If the target is 5 HD lower than you, they are frightened instead. These conditions last for 1d6 rounds. Any creature affected by the aura is immune to its effects for the duration of the aura.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer needs concentration.

Empower (2 cards) The aura radius increases by 5 feet.

Nine of Diamonds – Dismiss Summons

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one summoned creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

The target summoned creature is affected by the dismissal spell. The Will save is equal to your card casting DC.

Empower (1 cards) You can affect another summoned creature.

Ten of Diamonds – Paralyzing Breath

Traits enchantment

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range 15 feet
Area cone-shaped emanation
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You exhale out a cloud of paralyzing gas. Each creature in the area must make a Fortitude saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 round.

Empower (1 card) The cone range increases by 5 feet.

Jack of Diamonds – Distend

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

The target must make a Fortitude saving throw or be nauseated for 1 round. A successful save reduces the effect to sickened.

Empower (1 cards) You can affect another living creature.

Queen of Diamonds – Steal Summons

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one summoned creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You attempt to take control of the target summoned creature. You must make a caster level check against a DC of 10 + the caster level of the summoning spell. If you are successful, you take control of the summoned creature for the remaining duration.

King of Diamonds – Elemental Summons

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one summoned creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You can cast a summon monster spell equal to 1/2 your class level (minimum summon monster I). The monster(s) summoned must be elementals or a creature that would gain the celestial or fiendish template. Such creatures that would get the celestial or fiendish template are instead granted the minor elemental infusionPP20 template of your choice. For example a 8th-level cartomancer could summon a medium elemental of their choice or an elementally infused dire ape.

Clubs
Ace of Clubs – Force Retort

Traits evocation, force

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

If you take damage from a target within 30 feet of you, you launch a wave of force energy back at the target. The target takes 1d4 force damage +1d4 per 2 levels after 1st, and must make a Fortitude save or be knocked prone.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d4/CL.

Two of Clubs – Energy Claw

Traits acid, cold, electricity, evocation, fire

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

Choose one energy type from acid, cold, electricity, or fire. You grow claws infused with that energy type and make a touch attack against the target and deal 1d6 damage of the chosen energy type +1d6 per 2 levels after 1st.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d6/CL.

Three of Clubs – Painful Unraveling

Traits abjuration, force

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You may touch a creature and do a targeted dispel as per the spell dispel magic. You cannot dispel effects with a spell level greater than 1/2 your class level. If you dispel an effect, the target takes 1d6 force damage per level of the spell dispelled.

Empower (1 card) The range changes to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Four of Clubs – Chromatic Ball

Traits acid, cold, electricity, evocation, fire

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You launch a scintillating ball of chaotic color. You must make a ranged touch attack to affect the target. IF you hit, roll a 1d4. The target takes 1d6 damage of the type determined by the 1d4 roll on the table below + 1d6 for every 2 levels after 1st.

RollColorDamage

1 Red Fire2 Orange Acid3 Yellow Electricity4 Blue Cold

Five of Clubs – Thermal Transfer

Traits cold, evocation, fire

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target two creatures
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You drain the heat from one target and shunt it to another. Both targets must be within range. The initial target takes 1d6 cold damage + 1d6 per 2 levels after 1st.

The same damage rolled is dealt to the second target as fire damage. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage. Each target rolls their own save to halve the damage and the secondary target does not double-halve the damage.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d6/CL.

Six of Clubs – Force Bombardment

Traits evocation, force

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

This functions as the spell magic missile except as noted above.

Empower (2 cards) The maximum number of missiles increases by 1.

Seven of Clubs – Force Wave

Traits evocation, force

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range 15 feet
Area cone-shaped emanation
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You unleash a blast of force that deals 1d6 force damage plus 1d6 per two levels after 1st. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. On a failure, the target is pushed back 5 feet in addition to the damage. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Empower (1 card) The cone range increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) An affected creature is pushed back an additional 5 feet.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d6/CL.

Eight of Clubs – Distill Energy

Traits acid, conjuration, cold, electricity, fire

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range self
Effect elemental crystal
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You distill elemental energy into a sharp crystal. This crystal can be thrown as a standard ranged attack with a 30-foot range increment. If the attack hits, the target takes 1d4 + your Charisma modifier in piercing damage. If the attack misses, the crystal lands in the square of the target. Alternatively, the crystal can be placed as a free action. As a swift action during the duration, or at the end of the duration, you can cause the crystal to explode with the energy distilled into the crystal.

The target hit by the crystal or in the square occupied by the crystal takes 1d6 damage of the type distilled, plus 1d8 per 2 levels after 1st. Any creature in an adjacent square takes 1 damage of the same type per dice. A successful Reflex save halves the damage, but a creature struck by the crystal automatically fails.

Empower (2 cards) The duration becomes 1 min./level.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d8/CL (and by extension 1/CL to adjacent creatures).

Nine of Clubs – Pinball

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect rolling metal ball
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a metal ball. This effect acts as the spell flaming sphere except the damage dealt is bludgeoning damage and is 1d6 damage plus 1d6 per 2 levels after 1st.

If the sphere hits a creature, wall, or sufficiently large object, it bounces in a random direction, determined by the number of available vectors.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d6/CL.

Ten of Clubs – Creeping Flame

Traits evocation, fire

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one 5-foot square
Duration concentration, up to 3 rounds

DESCRIPTION

You toss a flaming sphere which deals 1d8 fire damage plus 1d8 per 2 levels after 1st, to the creature occupying the target square. A Reflex save halves this damage. On subsequent rounds, the squares adjacent to the target square are affected, then the rounds thereafter, the ring of fire expands another 5 feet. Creatures in the expanded areas take 1d6 fire damage plus 1d6 per 2 levels after 1st.

A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

Empower (1 card) The maximum duration increases by 1 round.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d8/CL and 1d6/CL.

Jack of Clubs – Chromatic Breath

Traits acid, cold, electricity, fire, transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You gain a breath weapon you can use as a swift action before the beginning of your next turn. The breath weapon is based upon the chromatic dragon type chosen as follows:

Dragon Type Area Damage Type Black 30-foot line Acid Blue 30-foot line Electricity Green 15-foot cone Acid Red 15-foot cone Fire White 15-foot cone Cold

The damage dealt by the breath weapon is 1d6 plus 1d6 per 2 levels after 1st. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

Empower (1 card) The range of the cone increases by 5 and the range of the line increases by 10 feet.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d6/CL.

Empower (2 cards) The duration increases by 1 round and you can use the breath weapon one additional time.

Queen of Clubs – Tormenting Teleport

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You touch the creature and shunt them through a portal that leads through the positive energy or negative energy plane unless they succeed on a Will save. On a failure, the target is teleported up to 30 feet to a point you designate and can see. They take 1d8 positive energy or negative energy damage (depending upon the portal chosen) plus 1d8 per 2 levels after 1st. The location teleported to must be able to support the target and not be intrinsically dangerous to them.

Empower (1 card) You can target one additional creature.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d8/CL.

Empower (2 cards) On a failure, the target is stunned for 1 round.

King of Clubs – Animate Construct

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one Small object per caster level; see text
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You gain the benefits of the spell animate objects except as noted above.

Spades
Ace of Spades – Magical Siphoning

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

When a spellcaster within 60 feet casts a spell, you can play this card to siphon off some of its power and gain a +1 bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

Empower (1 card) Increase the radius by 30 feet.

Empower (3 cards) Increase the bonus by 1.

Two of Spades – Illuminate Aura

Traits evocation, divination

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one glowing orb
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You create a glowing sphere that emits dim light out to 10 feet. Each magic item or active spell within the light emits its own glow for 5 feet. This glow corresponds to the school of magic for the magic item.

Empower (1 card) Increase the light radius by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Three of Spades – Flammable Grease

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one object or 10-ft. square
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

This functions as the spell grease except if any fire damage is dealt within its area, the grease catches on fire, burning all within for 1d8 fire damage plus 1d8 per 2 class levels after 1st. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. Prone creatures also catch fire as per the rules in the Core Rulebook.

Empower (1 card) The square size increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Empower (2 cards) The damage increases to 1d8/CL.

Four of Spades – Caltrop Field

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-foot radius area
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You cover the area with caltrops. See caltrop rules in the Core Rulebook for more information. The DC to avoid the effects of the caltrops is equal to your card casting DC.

Empower (1 card) The radius increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Empower (2 cards) The caltrops also float in the air and affect flying creatures.

Empower (2 cards) The caltrops are translucent and the DC to detect them increases by 20.

Five of Spades – Zone of Silence

Traits illusion

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range self
Area 10-foot radius emanation centered on you
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You emit a field as per the spell silence.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Empower (2 cards) The radius increases by 5 feet.

Six of Spades – Force Bubble

Traits evocation, force

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range self
Area 5-foot radius sphere
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You create a sphere of glowing force to protect you.

The sphere cannot move and attacks or abilities that would be blocked by a wall of force cannot go in or out of the sphere. The sphere itself has an AC equal to 10 + 1/2 your class level and hit points equal to 5 times your caster level. If the sphere is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed. The sphere cannot be created to intersect with another creature.

Empower (2 cards) The sphere’s radius increases by 5 feet.

Seven of Spades – Spell Erosion

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-foot cube
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

Create an area where spells are eroded faster than normal. Any active spells with a duration lose 1 round of duration in addition to the normal round used. This can only affect a spell once per round.

Empower (1 card) The cube’s size increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Empower (2 cards) The extra duration lost increases by 1.

Eight of Spades – Magic Barrier

Traits conjuration, force

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect 10-foot tall, 10-foot wide wall of force
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

This functions as a small wall of force except that the wall 14 is visible, has an AC equal to 10 + 1/2 your class level, and hit points equal to 5 times your caster level. If the wall is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

Empower (1 card) The wall’s length increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Nine of Spades – Dampen Energy

Traits abjuration, acid, cold, electricity, fire

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-foot cube
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

All creatures within the cube gain a 10 resistance to the chosen damage type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire).

Spells with those descriptors cannot be cast within the area unless the caste succeeds on a caster level check of 10 + your caster level.

Empower (1 card) The cube’s size increases by 5 feet in each dimension.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Empower (2 cards) The damage resistance increases by 10.

Empower (3 cards) You can choose another energy type to be affected.

Ten of Spades – Dispelling Barrier

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect 5-foot tall, 5-foot wide scintillating wall
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

The scintillating wall automatically subjects a target passing through it with the effects of dispel magic and spells that require line of effect cannot pass through the wall.

Empower (1 card) The cube’s size increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Jack of Spades – Miniaturization Aura

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range self
Effect 20-foot-radius emanation, centered on you
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

All creatures, excluding you, within the aura you emanate must make a Fortitude save or be affected by reduce person while within the aura and for 1 round thereafter. Once a creature has been affected by the aura, or succeeded on their save, they are immune to its effects for the remainder of the duration. Unlike reduce person this aura can affect all creatures regardless of type.

Empower (1 card) The aura increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Queen of Spades – Gravitational Circle

Traits transmutation

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Aura 10-foot radius, 40-foot tall cylinder
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

Each round, creatures within the aura are levitated 20 feet in the air. Creatures affected in this way are treated as if they are in an area of no gravity. Objects are also lifted on your turn. At the end of the duration, all creatures and objects drop.

Empower (1 card) The radius increases by 5 feet and the height increases by 10 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

King of Spades – Caress of the Far Realm

Traits conjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Aura 10-foot radius burst
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

Creatures in the area are affected as though by black tentacles except the tentacles do not deal any damage.

Empower (1 card) The radius increases by 5 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration no longer requires concentration.

Hearts Divine Deck
Ace of Hearts – Forestall Doom

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

You may play this card when hit with an attack. The damage is rolled normally, but is not applied to your hit points until the duration expires. You are then dealt the damage and any other effects of the attack.

Empower (1 card) The target changes to one willing creature within 30 feet.

Empower (1 card) The range increases by 30 feet.

Empower (1 card) The duration increases by 1 round.

Two of Hearts – Healing Touch

Traits conjuration, healing

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You touch the target healing them 1d6 hit points. The healing increases by 1d6 per 2 levels beyond 1st.

Empower (1 card) The range changes to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Empower (1 card) You add your Charisma to the amount healed.

Empower (2 cards) You can heal an additional creature within range.

Three of Hearts – Shielding Ward

Traits abjuration

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one willing creature
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You place a defensive ward around the creature, granting them a +2 deflection bonus to AC. This bonus increases by 1 for every three levels after 1st.

Empower (1 card) The range changes to close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).
